Many people now work from home. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?

franklin.text: One major advantage of working from home is the time it saves. Commuters in large cities often spend more than an hour travelling each day, which leaves them tired before work has even begun. When this journey disappears, employees can use the extra time to exercise, rest or study, and as a result they tend to feel more focused. For example, a recent survey of office workers in Seoul found that most remote staff slept longer and reported lower stress.

Overall, Canada used far more electricity per household than the other two countries throughout the period, although its figure fell slightly. Korea was the only country to show steady growth, rising from about 4,200 to 6,900 kilowatt hours. By contrast, consumption in the UK declined gradually and ended the period at the lowest level.
